description: Dear Neighbor,One thing I hear consistently from people across Onslow County is concern about the rising cost of owning a home and the impact property taxes can have on a family’s budget. That’s why I’m grateful for the opportunity to serve on the new Senate Select Committee on Property Tax Reform and take a closer look at what can be done to bring greater transparency and predictability to the process.As we begin that work, I want to hear from the people directly affected. title: The Onslow Observer: Property Taxes, NASA Astronaut Visit, & More...
